## 7. Calculation of Pension  
[ Swamy's Pension Compilation I  
Full pension is admissible to an employee retiring with rmrurnurn qualifying service of oot less than 10 years. The amount of pension will be 50% of the average emo luments or 50% of emoluments drawn on the date of retirement, whichever is more beneficial.  
The amount of pension shall be subject to a minimum of z 9,000 per month and the maximum pension of z 1,25,000 p.m. - Rule 44 (1).
